turns.text: In September 2026, the cost per acquisition / cost per booking (CPA) for the **search** channel was **€124.84**, based on a total ad spend of **€3,870.00** and **31** bookings.

args.sql:
WITH spend_data AS
  (SELECT SUM(asp.spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS asp
   INNER JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS CMP ON asp.campaign_id = cmp.campaign_id
   WHERE LOWER(cmp.channel) = 'search'
     AND asp.spend_date >= '2026-09-01'
     AND asp.spend_date <= '2026-09-30' ),
     booking_data AS
  (SELECT COUNT(b.booking_id) AS total_bookings
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings` AS b
   INNER JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS CMP ON b.campaign_id = cmp.campaign_id
   WHERE LOWER(cmp.channel) = 'search'
     AND b.booked_date >= '2026-09-01'
     AND b.booked_date <= '2026-09-30' )
SELECT s.total_spend AS search_spend_eur,
       b.total_bookings AS search_bookings,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(s.total_spend, b.total_bookings), 2) AS cost_per_booking_eur
FROM spend_data AS s
CROSS JOIN booking_data AS b;

turns.text: During the last fiscal quarter (Fiscal Q3 2026: **2026-08-01** to **2026-10-31**), there were **217** total orders (including cancelled ones).

args.sql:
WITH current_info AS
  (SELECT date_day,
          fiscal_quarter,
          fiscal_year
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine`
   WHERE date_day = DATE '2026-11-10' ),
     previous_quarter AS
  (SELECT MAX(t.fiscal_quarter) AS prev_fiscal_quarter
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine` t
   JOIN current_info c ON t.fiscal_quarter < c.fiscal_quarter),
     target_range AS
  (SELECT MIN(t.date_day) AS start_date,
          MAX(t.date_day) AS end_date,
          p.prev_fiscal_quarter
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine` t
   JOIN previous_quarter p ON t.fiscal_quarter = p.prev_fiscal_quarter
   GROUP BY p.prev_fiscal_quarter)
SELECT tr.prev_fiscal_quarter AS fiscal_quarter_start,
       tr.start_date,
       tr.end_date,
       COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders
FROM target_range tr
LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` o ON o.order_date BETWEEN tr.start_date AND tr.end_date
GROUP BY tr.prev_fiscal_quarter,
         tr.start_date,
         tr.end_date

turns.text: Our net revenue for the fiscal year to date (from 1 February 2026 through 6 October 2026) is **€19,521.84**, derived from €19,611.59 in gross revenue minus €89.75 in returns.

args.sql:
WITH fiscal_info AS
  (SELECT fiscal_year
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine`
   WHERE date_day = DATE '2026-10-06' ),
     gross_rev AS
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS gross_revenue
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o
   CROSS JOIN fiscal_info AS f
   WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'
     AND o.order_date >= f.fiscal_year
     AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-10-06' ),
     ret AS
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) AS returns_amount
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns` AS r
   CROSS JOIN fiscal_info AS f
   WHERE r.return_date >= f.fiscal_year
     AND r.return_date <= DATE '2026-10-06' )
SELECT f.fiscal_year AS fiscal_year_start,
       DATE '2026-10-06' AS as_of_date,
       g.gross_revenue,
       r.returns_amount,
       (g.gross_revenue - r.returns_amount) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM fiscal_info AS f
CROSS JOIN gross_rev AS g
CROSS JOIN ret AS r;

turns.text: Revenue on Thursday, 24 September 2026 was **€542.00**, representing an increase of **21.12%** compared to **€447.50** on Thursday, 17 September 2026, calculated based on non-cancelled orders and week-over-week growth.

args.sql:
WITH daily_revenue AS
  (SELECT order_date,
          SUM(amount) AS revenue_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE status != 'cancelled'
     AND order_date IN (DATE '2026-09-24', DATE '2026-09-17')
   GROUP BY order_date)
SELECT r_curr.order_date AS CURRENT_DATE,
       r_curr.revenue_eur AS current_revenue_eur,
       r_prev.order_date AS previous_date,
       r_prev.revenue_eur AS previous_revenue_eur,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(r_curr.revenue_eur - r_prev.revenue_eur, r_prev.revenue_eur) * 100, 2) AS revenue_growth_percentage
FROM
  (SELECT *
   FROM daily_revenue
   WHERE order_date = DATE '2026-09-24') AS r_curr
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT *
   FROM daily_revenue
   WHERE order_date = DATE '2026-09-17') AS r_prev ON TRUE

turns.text: I assumed "best week" refers to the highest weekly figures across both primary sales metrics: Order Revenue and Booking Value, grouping weeks from Monday to Sunday. The best performing week between Monday 17 August and Sunday 27 September 2026 was the week of **Monday, 21 September 2026 to Sunday, 27 September 2026**, generating **€3,387.25** in order revenue (26 non-cancelled orders) and **€33,300.00** in booking value (13 bookings). ### Weekly Performance Summary - **Order Revenue Peak:** The week of **21–27 September 2026** generated the highest weekly revenue at **€3,387.25**, marking consistent weekly revenue growth from early September. - **Booking Value Peak:** The same week (**21–27 September 2026**) also achieved the highest weekly booking value at **€33,300.00** across 13 bookings, closely followed by the preceding week of 14–20 September (€33,200.00 across 14 bookings).

args.sql:
WITH weekly_orders AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(order_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(CASE
                  WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN amount
                  ELSE 0
              END) AS revenue_eur,
          COUNT(CASE
                    WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN order_id
                END) AS non_cancelled_orders
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY week_start),
     weekly_bookings AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(booked_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(amount) AS booking_value_eur,
          COUNT(booking_id) AS total_bookings
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings`
   WHERE booked_date BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY week_start),
     all_weeks AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC(date_day, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine`
   WHERE date_day BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-09-27' )
SELECT w.week_start,
       DATE_ADD(w.week_start, INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS week_end,
       COALESCE(o.revenue_eur, 0) AS revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(b.booking_value_eur, 0) AS booking_value_eur,
       COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0) AS bookings_count,
       COALESCE(o.non_cancelled_orders, 0) AS orders_count
FROM all_weeks w
LEFT JOIN weekly_orders o ON w.week_start = o.week_start
LEFT JOIN weekly_bookings b ON w.week_start = b.week_start
ORDER BY w.week_start;

WITH weekly_orders AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(order_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(CASE
                  WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN amount
                  ELSE 0
              END) AS revenue_eur,
          COUNT(CASE
                    WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN order_id
                END) AS non_cancelled_orders
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY week_start),
     weekly_bookings AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(booked_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(amount) AS booking_value_eur,
          COUNT(booking_id) AS total_bookings
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings`
   WHERE booked_date BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY week_start),
     all_weeks AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC(date_day, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine`
   WHERE date_day BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-09-27' )
SELECT w.week_start,
       DATE_ADD(w.week_start, INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS week_end,
       COALESCE(o.revenue_eur, 0) AS revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(b.booking_value_eur, 0) AS booking_value_eur,
       COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0) AS bookings_count,
       COALESCE(o.non_cancelled_orders, 0) AS orders_count
FROM all_weeks w
LEFT JOIN weekly_orders o ON w.week_start = o.week_start
LEFT JOIN weekly_bookings b ON w.week_start = b.week_start
ORDER BY w.week_start;

turns.text: In **Fiscal Q3 2026** (August 1, 2026 – October 31, 2026), gross revenue was **€19,793.59** (with €89.75 in returns, yielding a net revenue of **€19,703.84**). For **Calendar Q3 2026** (July 1, 2026 – September 30, 2026), gross revenue was **€17,656.25** (with €0 in returns, resulting in **€17,656.25** net revenue). Per the semantic time spine definition, Fiscal Q3 2026 spans 2026-08-01 to 2026-10-31 (the fiscal year starts February 1). Both Fiscal Q3 and standard Calendar Q3 (2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30) metrics, along with gross and net revenue, are provided for completeness.

args.sql:
WITH orders_filtered AS
  (SELECT o.order_id,
          o.order_date,
          o.amount,
          o.status
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o
   WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-10-31'
     AND LOWER(o.status) != 'cancelled' ),
     returns_filtered AS
  (SELECT r.amount
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns` AS r
   WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-10-31' ),
     calendar_q3_orders AS
  (SELECT o.order_id,
          o.order_date,
          o.amount,
          o.status
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o
   WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
     AND LOWER(o.status) != 'cancelled' ),
     calendar_q3_returns AS
  (SELECT r.amount
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns` AS r
   WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' )
SELECT 'Fiscal Q3 2026 (2026-08-01 to 2026-10-31)' AS period,
       SUM(o.amount) AS revenue_eur,

  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)
   FROM returns_filtered) AS returns_eur,
       SUM(o.amount) -
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)
   FROM returns_filtered) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM orders_filtered AS o
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Calendar Q3 2026 (2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30)' AS period,
       SUM(o.amount) AS revenue_eur,

  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)
   FROM calendar_q3_returns) AS returns_eur,
       SUM(o.amount) -
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)
   FROM calendar_q3_returns) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM calendar_q3_orders AS o

WITH spend_by_channel AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          SUM(s.spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS s
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE s.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
   GROUP BY c.channel),
     leads_by_channel AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          COUNT(l.lead_id) AS total_leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads` AS l
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE l.created_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
   GROUP BY c.channel)
SELECT COALESCE(s.channel, l.channel) AS channel,
       COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) AS total_spend_eur,
       COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0) AS total_leads,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0), COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0)), 2) AS cost_per_lead_eur
FROM spend_by_channel AS s
FULL OUTER JOIN leads_by_channel AS l ON s.channel = l.channel
ORDER BY cost_per_lead_eur ASC

turns.text: Between 20 September and 3 October 2026, the **cart abandonment rate was 60.0%** (3 out of 5 cart sessions were abandoned without checking out within the cart-to-checkout attribution window).

args.sql:
WITH cart_events AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT session_id,
                   event_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customer_actions`
   WHERE action_type = 'add_to_cart'
     AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-03' ),
     checkout_events AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT session_id,
                   event_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customer_actions`
   WHERE action_type = 'checkout' ),
     cart_with_checkout AS
  (SELECT c.session_id,
          c.event_date,
          CASE
              WHEN EXISTS
                     (SELECT 1
                      FROM checkout_events chk
                      WHERE chk.session_id = c.session_id
                        AND chk.event_date BETWEEN c.event_date AND DATE_ADD(c.event_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) THEN 1
              ELSE 0
          END AS checked_out
   FROM cart_events c)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS cart_sessions,
       SUM(checked_out) AS converted_sessions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) - SUM(checked_out) AS abandoned_cart_sessions,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(checked_out), COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)) * 100, 2) AS cart_to_checkout_rate_pct,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) - SUM(checked_out), COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)) * 100, 2) AS cart_abandonment_rate_pct
FROM cart_with_checkout;

SELECT CAST(os.order_date AS STRING) AS period,

turns.text: The **social** channel's cost per booking rose the most from the week of 14 September 2026 to the week of 21 September 2026, increasing by **27 EUR** (from 98 EUR to 125 EUR).

args.sql:
WITH weekly_spend AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          DATE_TRUNC(s.spend_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(s.spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS s
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE s.spend_date >= '2026-09-14'
     AND s.spend_date <= '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY c.channel,
            week_start),
     weekly_bookings AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          DATE_TRUNC(b.booked_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          COUNT(b.booking_id) AS total_bookings
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings` AS b
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON b.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE b.booked_date >= '2026-09-14'
     AND b.booked_date <= '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY c.channel,
            week_start),
     weekly_metrics AS
  (SELECT COALESCE(s.channel, b.channel) AS channel,
          COALESCE(s.week_start, b.week_start) AS week_start,
          COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) AS total_spend,
          COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0) AS total_bookings,
          SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0), COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0)) AS cost_per_booking
   FROM weekly_spend s
   FULL OUTER JOIN weekly_bookings b ON s.channel = b.channel
   AND s.week_start = b.week_start),
     pivoted AS
  (SELECT channel,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = '2026-09-14' THEN cost_per_booking
              END) AS cpb_sep_14,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = '2026-09-21' THEN cost_per_booking
              END) AS cpb_sep_21,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = '2026-09-14' THEN total_spend
              END) AS spend_sep_14,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = '2026-09-14' THEN total_bookings
              END) AS bookings_sep_14,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = '2026-09-21' THEN total_spend
              END) AS spend_sep_21,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = '2026-09-21' THEN total_bookings
              END) AS bookings_sep_21
   FROM weekly_metrics
   GROUP BY channel)
SELECT channel,
       cpb_sep_14,
       cpb_sep_21,
       (cpb_sep_21 - cpb_sep_14) AS cpb_increase,
       spend_sep_14,
       bookings_sep_14,
       spend_sep_21,
       bookings_sep_21
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY cpb_increase DESC NULLS LAST;

args.sql:
WITH monthly_aov AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(order_date, MONTH) AS order_month,
          SUM(amount) AS revenue_eur,
          COUNT(*) AS non_cancelled_orders,
          SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(amount), COUNT(*)) AS aov_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE status != 'cancelled'
     AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
   GROUP BY order_month)
SELECT aug.aov_eur AS august_aov_eur,
       sep.aov_eur AS september_aov_eur,
       sep.aov_eur - aug.aov_eur AS aov_growth_eur
FROM
  (SELECT aov_eur
   FROM monthly_aov
   WHERE order_month = DATE '2026-08-01') AS aug
CROSS JOIN
  (SELECT aov_eur
   FROM monthly_aov
   WHERE order_month = DATE '2026-09-01') AS sep;

turns.text: Out of the 6 candidates who applied between 25 September and 2 October 2026, **2 candidates (33.3%)** were still actively in the hiring pipeline (in the running, i.e., in `screen` or `interview` stages) at the end of 4 October 2026. Of the remaining 4 candidates: - **2 candidates (33.3%)** were already hired. - **2 candidates (33.3%)** were rejected. I assumed 'still in the running' refers to candidates actively in the recruitment funnel (not yet hired or rejected) at the end of 4 October 2026 based on candidate stage history.

args.sql:
WITH cohort AS
  (SELECT candidate_id,
          applied_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001`.`silver`.`applications`
   WHERE applied_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-02' ),
     candidate_status_at_oct4 AS
  (SELECT c.candidate_id, -- Find the candidate's stage valid at the end of 2026-10-04 (valid_from_date <= 2026-10-04 AND (valid_to_date > 2026-10-04 OR valid_to_date IS NULL))
 cs.stage 
   FROM cohort AS c 
   LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001`.`silver`.`candidate_stages` AS cs ON c.candidate_id = cs.candidate_id 
   AND cs.valid_from_date <= DATE '2026-10-04' 
   AND (cs.valid_to_date > DATE '2026-10-04'
        OR cs.valid_to_date IS NULL))
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_applied, 
       COUNTIF(stage NOT IN ('rejected', 'hired')
               AND stage IS NOT NULL) AS in_running_count, 
       COUNTIF(stage = 'rejected') AS rejected_count, 
       COUNTIF(stage = 'hired') AS hired_count, 
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(stage NOT IN ('rejected', 'hired')
                                 AND stage IS NOT NULL), COUNT(*)) * 100, 1) AS in_running_share_pct, -- Also compute active/in-process vs hired/rejected breakdown
 ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(stage NOT IN ('rejected')), COUNT(*)) * 100, 1) AS non_rejected_share_pct
FROM candidate_status_at_oct4;

SELECT a.candidate_id,
       a.role,
       a.applied_date,
       cs.stage AS stage_at_end_of_oct_4,
       a.current_stage
FROM `pplk8s-lab-001`.`silver`.`applications` AS a
LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001`.`silver`.`candidate_stages` AS cs ON a.candidate_id = cs.candidate_id
AND cs.valid_from_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
AND (cs.valid_to_date > DATE '2026-10-04'
     OR cs.valid_to_date IS NULL)
WHERE a.applied_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-02'
ORDER BY a.applied_date,
         a.candidate_id;

turns.text: I assumed 'first-time buyer' refers to a customer's very first non-cancelled order across all time, and 'returning customer' refers to any subsequent non-cancelled order, following the standard definition of non-cancelled orders for Average Order Value. Between 1 and 10 October 2026, a first-time buyer's order came to **€33.01 less** on average than a returning customer's (average order value of **€41.00** for first-time buyers vs. **€74.01** for returning customers, considering non-cancelled orders).

args.sql:
WITH order_ranks AS
  (SELECT order_id,
          customer_id,
          order_date,
          amount,
          status,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id
                             ORDER BY order_ts,
                                      order_id) AS customer_order_seq
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`),
     period_orders AS
  (SELECT order_id,
          customer_id,
          order_date,
          amount,
          status,
          CASE
              WHEN customer_order_seq = 1 THEN 'first_time'
              ELSE 'returning'
          END AS buyer_type
   FROM order_ranks
   WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
     AND LOWER(status) != 'cancelled' ),
     aov_by_type AS
  (SELECT buyer_type,
          COUNT(order_id) AS order_count,
          SUM(amount) AS total_revenue,
          AVG(amount) AS avg_order_value
   FROM period_orders
   GROUP BY buyer_type)
SELECT MAX(CASE
               WHEN buyer_type = 'first_time' THEN avg_order_value
           END) AS first_time_aov,
       MAX(CASE
               WHEN buyer_type = 'returning' THEN avg_order_value
           END) AS returning_aov,
       MAX(CASE
               WHEN buyer_type = 'returning' THEN avg_order_value
           END) - MAX(CASE
                          WHEN buyer_type = 'first_time' THEN avg_order_value
                      END) AS difference_eur
FROM aov_by_type;

WITH oct_orders AS
  (SELECT o.order_id,
          o.amount,
          o.status,
          o.order_date,
          c.country
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` o
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customers` c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
   WHERE c.country = 'DE'
     AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-12' ),
     oct_returns AS
  (SELECT r.amount,
          r.return_date,
          c.country
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns` r
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customers` c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id
   WHERE c.country = 'DE'
     AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-12' )
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE
                        WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN amount
                        ELSE 0
                    END), 0) AS gross_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(
                  (SELECT SUM(amount)
                   FROM oct_returns), 0) AS returns_eur,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE
                        WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN amount
                        ELSE 0
                    END), 0) - COALESCE(
                                          (SELECT SUM(amount)
                                           FROM oct_returns), 0) AS net_revenue_eur,
       COUNT(CASE
                 WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN order_id
             END) AS non_cancelled_orders_count,
       COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders_count
FROM oct_orders

args.sql:
WITH channel_spend AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          SUM(s.spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS s
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE s.spend_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
   GROUP BY c.channel),
     channel_leads AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          COUNT(l.lead_id) AS total_leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads` AS l
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE l.created_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
   GROUP BY c.channel)
SELECT COALESCE(s.channel, l.channel) AS channel,
       COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) AS total_spend_eur,
       COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0) AS total_leads,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0), l.total_leads), 2) AS cost_per_lead_eur
FROM channel_spend AS s
FULL OUTER JOIN channel_leads AS l ON s.channel = l.channel
WHERE COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0) > 0
ORDER BY cost_per_lead_eur ASC

turns.text: Between 20 September and 3 October 2026, the cart abandonment rate was **60.0%** (3 out of 5 cart sessions did not result in a checkout on the same day or the next day, corresponding to a cart-to-checkout rate of 40.0%). Cart abandonment rate is calculated as 100% minus the cart-to-checkout conversion rate, where a checkout must occur on the add-to-cart day or the following day for the same site session.

args.sql:
WITH cart_sessions AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT session_id,
                   event_date AS cart_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customer_actions`
   WHERE action_type = 'add_to_cart'
     AND channel = 'site'
     AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-03' ),
     checkout_actions AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT session_id,
                   event_date AS checkout_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customer_actions`
   WHERE action_type = 'checkout'
     AND channel = 'site' )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.session_id) AS total_cart_sessions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                          WHEN ch.session_id IS NOT NULL
                               AND ch.checkout_date BETWEEN c.cart_date AND DATE_ADD(c.cart_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN c.session_id
                      END) AS converted_cart_sessions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                          WHEN ch.session_id IS NULL
                               OR ch.checkout_date NOT BETWEEN c.cart_date AND DATE_ADD(c.cart_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN c.session_id
                      END) AS abandoned_cart_sessions,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                                            WHEN ch.session_id IS NULL
                                                 OR ch.checkout_date NOT BETWEEN c.cart_date AND DATE_ADD(c.cart_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN c.session_id
                                        END), COUNT(DISTINCT c.session_id)) * 100, 1) AS cart_abandonment_rate_pct,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                                            WHEN ch.session_id IS NOT NULL
                                                 AND ch.checkout_date BETWEEN c.cart_date AND DATE_ADD(c.cart_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN c.session_id
                                        END), COUNT(DISTINCT c.session_id)) * 100, 1) AS cart_to_checkout_rate_pct
FROM cart_sessions AS c
LEFT JOIN checkout_actions AS ch ON c.session_id = ch.session_id;

WITH campaign_month_end AS

          budget_eur,
          remaining_eur,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id
                             ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC) AS rn
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaign_budgets`
   WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' ),
     september_totals AS

SELECT total_budget_eur,
       total_remaining_eur,
       total_spent_eur,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(total_spent_eur, total_budget_eur) * 100, 1) AS budget_spent_percentage

turns.text: Ad spend grew by **6.01%** (an increase of €85, from €1,415 to €1,500) in the week of 14 September 2026 compared to the week before.

args.sql:
WITH weekly_spend AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(spend_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend`
   WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-07' AND DATE '2026-09-20'
   GROUP BY week_start)
SELECT w_current.week_start AS current_week,
       w_current.total_spend AS current_week_spend,
       w_previous.week_start AS previous_week,
       w_previous.total_spend AS previous_week_spend,
       w_current.total_spend - w_previous.total_spend AS spend_difference,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(w_current.total_spend - w_previous.total_spend, w_previous.total_spend) * 100, 2) AS growth_percentage
FROM weekly_spend AS w_current
LEFT JOIN weekly_spend AS w_previous ON w_previous.week_start = DATE_SUB(w_current.week_start, INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
WHERE w_current.week_start = DATE '2026-09-14';

turns.text: The channel whose cost per booking rose the most from the week of 14 September 2026 to the week of 21 September 2026 was **social**, increasing by **€27.00** (from €98.00 to €125.00).

args.sql:
WITH weeks AS
  (SELECT DATE '2026-09-14' AS week_start,
          DATE '2026-09-20' AS week_end,
          '2026-09-14' AS week_label
   UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2026-09-21' AS week_start,
                    DATE '2026-09-27' AS week_end,
                    '2026-09-21' AS week_label),
     channel_spend AS
  (SELECT w.week_label,
          c.channel,
          SUM(s.spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS s
   INNER JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   INNER JOIN weeks AS w ON s.spend_date BETWEEN w.week_start AND w.week_end
   GROUP BY w.week_label,
            c.channel),
     channel_bookings AS
  (SELECT w.week_label,
          c.channel,
          COUNT(b.booking_id) AS total_bookings
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings` AS b
   INNER JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON b.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   INNER JOIN weeks AS w ON b.booked_date BETWEEN w.week_start AND w.week_end
   GROUP BY w.week_label,
            c.channel),
     channels AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT channel
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns`),
     weekly_metrics AS
  (SELECT ch.channel,
          w.week_label,
          COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) AS spend,
          COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0) AS bookings,
          SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0), COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0)) AS cost_per_booking
   FROM channels AS ch
   CROSS JOIN weeks AS w
   LEFT JOIN channel_spend AS s ON ch.channel = s.channel
   AND w.week_label = s.week_label
   LEFT JOIN channel_bookings AS b ON ch.channel = b.channel
   AND w.week_label = b.week_label),
     pivoted AS
  (SELECT channel,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_label = '2026-09-14' THEN spend
              END) AS spend_w1,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_label = '2026-09-14' THEN bookings
              END) AS bookings_w1,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_label = '2026-09-14' THEN cost_per_booking
              END) AS cpb_w1,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_label = '2026-09-21' THEN spend
              END) AS spend_w2,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_label = '2026-09-21' THEN bookings
              END) AS bookings_w2,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_label = '2026-09-21' THEN cost_per_booking
              END) AS cpb_w2
   FROM weekly_metrics
   GROUP BY channel)
SELECT channel,
       cpb_w1 AS cpb_week_2026_09_14,
       cpb_w2 AS cpb_week_2026_09_21,
       ROUND(cpb_w2 - cpb_w1, 2) AS cpb_increase_eur
FROM pivoted
WHERE cpb_w1 IS NOT NULL
  AND cpb_w2 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cpb_increase_eur DESC;

turns.text: Based on the definition of Average order value (EUR) (revenue over non-cancelled orders), the average order value grew by **€22.14** from August 2026 (€92.25) to September 2026 (€114.39).

args.sql:
WITH monthly_aov AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(order_date, MONTH) AS order_month,
          SUM(amount) AS revenue_eur,
          COUNT(order_id) AS non_cancelled_orders,
          SUM(amount) / COUNT(order_id) AS avg_order_value_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE status != 'cancelled'
     AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
   GROUP BY 1)
SELECT aug.avg_order_value_eur AS aug_aov,
       sep.avg_order_value_eur AS sep_aov,
       sep.avg_order_value_eur - aug.avg_order_value_eur AS aov_growth_eur
FROM
  (SELECT avg_order_value_eur
   FROM monthly_aov
   WHERE order_month = DATE '2026-08-01') AS aug
CROSS JOIN
  (SELECT avg_order_value_eur
   FROM monthly_aov
   WHERE order_month = DATE '2026-09-01') AS sep;

       COUNTIF(first_replied_ts IS NOT NULL

Based on definitions for Average order value and Repeat customers (customers with 2+ lifetime orders), non-cancelled orders were evaluated: - **Returning Customers:** Average Order Value of **€74.01** across 25 orders (€1,850.34 total revenue). - **First-Time Buyers:** Average Order Value of **€41.00** across 7 orders (€287.00 total revenue). - **Difference:** €74.0136 - €41.0000 = **€33.0136**.

args.sql:
WITH customer_order_counts AS
  (SELECT customer_id,
          COUNT(*) AS total_orders
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   GROUP BY customer_id),
     classified_orders AS
  (SELECT o.order_id,
          o.order_date,
          o.amount,
          o.status,
          o.customer_id,

              WHEN c.total_orders >= 2 THEN 'repeat'
              ELSE 'first_time'
          END AS customer_type
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o
   JOIN customer_order_counts AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

     AND LOWER(o.status) != 'cancelled' )
SELECT customer_type,
       COUNT(order_id) AS order_count,
       SUM(amount) AS total_revenue,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(amount), COUNT(order_id)) AS avg_order_value, -- Also calculate the difference in one query:
 MAX(CASE
         WHEN customer_type = 'repeat' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(amount), COUNT(order_id))
     END) OVER () - MAX(CASE
                            WHEN customer_type = 'first_time' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(amount), COUNT(order_id))
                        END) OVER () AS repeat_minus_first_time_diff
FROM classified_orders

WITH channel_spend AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          SUM(s.spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS s
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE s.spend_date >= '2026-09-01'
     AND s.spend_date <= '2026-09-30'
     AND LOWER(c.channel) IN ('social',
                              'search')
   GROUP BY c.channel),
     channel_leads AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          COUNT(l.lead_id) AS total_leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads` AS l
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE l.created_date >= '2026-09-01'
     AND l.created_date <= '2026-09-30'
     AND LOWER(c.channel) IN ('social',
                              'search')
   GROUP BY c.channel),
     combined AS
  (SELECT cs.channel,
          cs.total_spend,
          COALESCE(cl.total_leads, 0) AS total_leads,
          SAFE_DIVIDE(cs.total_spend, cl.total_leads) AS cost_per_lead_eur
   FROM channel_spend AS cs
   LEFT JOIN channel_leads AS cl ON cs.channel = cl.channel)
SELECT channel,
       total_spend,
       total_leads,
       cost_per_lead_eur,

  (SELECT cost_per_lead_eur
   FROM combined
   WHERE LOWER(channel) = 'social') -
  (SELECT cost_per_lead_eur
   FROM combined
   WHERE LOWER(channel) = 'search') AS diff_social_minus_search_eur
FROM combined;

WITH calendar_days AS
  (SELECT ts.date_day,
          CASE
              WHEN EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK
                           FROM ts.date_day) IN (1,
                                                 7) THEN 'Weekend (Sat-Sun)'
              ELSE 'Weekday (Mon-Fri)'
          END AS day_type
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine` AS ts
   WHERE ts.date_day BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-17' AND DATE '2026-09-27' ),
     daily_rev AS
  (SELECT cd.date_day,
          cd.day_type,
          COALESCE(SUM(CASE
                           WHEN ord.status != 'cancelled' THEN ord.amount
                           ELSE 0
                       END), 0) AS daily_revenue_amount
   FROM calendar_days AS cd
   LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS ord ON cd.date_day = ord.order_date
   GROUP BY cd.date_day,
            cd.day_type)
SELECT dr.day_type,
       COUNT(dr.date_day) AS total_days,
       ROUND(SUM(dr.daily_revenue_amount), 2) AS total_revenue_eur,
       ROUND(AVG(dr.daily_revenue_amount), 2) AS avg_daily_revenue_eur
FROM daily_rev AS dr
GROUP BY dr.day_type
ORDER BY dr.day_type DESC;

SELECT r_curr.order_date AS CURRENT_DATE,
       r_curr.revenue AS current_revenue,

turns.text: Cart abandonment rate is calculated as 1 minus the cart-to-checkout rate (the complement of sessions that checked out on the day of add-to-cart or the day after). Let me know if you would like a different attribution window applied. Between 20 September and 3 October 2026, the **cart abandonment rate was 60.0%** (3 out of 5 cart sessions abandoned without checking out within the standard 1-day checkout window).

args.sql:
WITH cart_sessions AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT session_id,
                   event_date AS cart_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customer_actions`
   WHERE action_type = 'add_to_cart'
     AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-03' ),
     checkout_sessions AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT session_id,
                   event_date AS checkout_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customer_actions`
   WHERE action_type = 'checkout' ),
     cart_outcomes AS
  (SELECT c.session_id,
          c.cart_date,
          CASE
              WHEN ch.session_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1
              ELSE 0
          END AS checked_out
   FROM cart_sessions c
   LEFT JOIN checkout_sessions ch ON c.session_id = ch.session_id
   AND ch.checkout_date BETWEEN c.cart_date AND DATE_ADD(c.cart_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY))
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS total_cart_sessions,
       SUM(checked_out) AS checked_out_sessions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) - SUM(checked_out) AS abandoned_cart_sessions,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(checked_out), COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)) * 100, 2) AS cart_to_checkout_rate_percentage,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) - SUM(checked_out), COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)) * 100, 2) AS cart_abandonment_rate_percentage
FROM cart_outcomes;

            week_start),
     channel_weeks AS
  (SELECT COALESCE(s.channel, b.channel) AS channel,
          COALESCE(s.week_start, b.week_start) AS week_start,
          COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) AS total_spend,
          COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0) AS total_bookings,
          SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0), COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0)) AS cost_per_booking
   FROM spend_by_week AS s
   FULL OUTER JOIN bookings_by_week AS b ON s.channel = b.channel
   AND s.week_start = b.week_start),
     pivoted AS
  (SELECT channel,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = DATE '2026-09-14' THEN cost_per_booking
              END) AS cpb_w14,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = DATE '2026-09-21' THEN cost_per_booking
              END) AS cpb_w21,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = DATE '2026-09-14' THEN total_spend
              END) AS spend_w14,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = DATE '2026-09-14' THEN total_bookings
              END) AS bookings_w14,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = DATE '2026-09-21' THEN total_spend
              END) AS spend_w21,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = DATE '2026-09-21' THEN total_bookings
              END) AS bookings_w21
   FROM channel_weeks
   GROUP BY channel)
SELECT channel,
       cpb_w14,
       cpb_w21,
       spend_w14,
       bookings_w14,
       spend_w21,
       bookings_w21,
       (cpb_w21 - cpb_w14) AS cpb_diff
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY cpb_diff DESC NULLS LAST

   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o

If evaluated by booking count alone, the week of **14 September to 20 September 2026** had the highest volume with **14 bookings** (€33,200.00 booking value; €3,104.75 order revenue). ### Weekly Performance Breakdown - **Peak E-commerce Order Revenue**: Week 6 (2026-09-21 to 2026-09-27) reached the highest gross/net revenue at **€3,387.25**, a 58.2% increase compared to Week 1 (€2,141.25). - **Peak Booking Value**: Week 6 also led in total booking value at **€33,300.00** across 13 bookings, narrowly edging out Week 5 (€33,200.00 across 14 bookings). - **Zero Returns**: No partner returns were recorded during this 6-week window, keeping net revenue equal to gross revenue throughout.

args.sql:
WITH weeks AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_day, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(date_day, WEEK(MONDAY)), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS week_end
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine`
   WHERE date_day BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-17' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY 1,
            2),
     orders_agg AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(order_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders,
          SUM(CASE
                  WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN amount
                  ELSE 0
              END) AS revenue_eur,
          COUNT(CASE
                    WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN order_id
                END) AS completed_orders
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-17' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY 1),
     returns_agg AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(return_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(amount) AS returns_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns`
   WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-17' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY 1),
     bookings_agg AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(booked_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          COUNT(booking_id) AS bookings_count,
          SUM(amount) AS booking_value_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings`
   WHERE booked_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-17' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY 1)
SELECT w.week_start,
       w.week_end,
       COALESCE(o.revenue_eur, 0) AS revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(r.returns_eur, 0) AS returns_eur,
       COALESCE(o.revenue_eur, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_eur, 0) AS net_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(o.completed_orders, 0) AS completed_orders,
       COALESCE(b.bookings_count, 0) AS bookings_count,
       COALESCE(b.booking_value_eur, 0) AS booking_value_eur
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN orders_agg o ON w.week_start = o.week_start
LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON w.week_start = r.week_start
LEFT JOIN bookings_agg b ON w.week_start = b.week_start
ORDER BY w.week_start;

Cart abandonment rate is defined as 1 minus the cart-to-checkout rate, where a checkout is attributed if completed on the same day as the add-to-cart or the day after.

WITH cart_sessions AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT session_id,
                   event_date AS cart_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customer_actions`
   WHERE action_type = 'add_to_cart'
     AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-03' ),
     checkout_actions AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT session_id,
                   event_date AS checkout_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customer_actions`
   WHERE action_type = 'checkout' )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.session_id) AS total_cart_sessions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                          WHEN ca.session_id IS NOT NULL
                               AND ca.checkout_date BETWEEN cs.cart_date AND DATE_ADD(cs.cart_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN cs.session_id
                      END) AS checkout_sessions,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                                            WHEN ca.session_id IS NOT NULL
                                                 AND ca.checkout_date BETWEEN cs.cart_date AND DATE_ADD(cs.cart_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN cs.session_id
                                        END), COUNT(DISTINCT cs.session_id)) * 100, 2) AS cart_to_checkout_rate_pct,
       ROUND((1 - SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                                                 WHEN ca.session_id IS NOT NULL
                                                      AND ca.checkout_date BETWEEN cs.cart_date AND DATE_ADD(cs.cart_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN cs.session_id
                                             END), COUNT(DISTINCT cs.session_id))) * 100, 2) AS cart_abandonment_rate_pct
FROM cart_sessions cs
LEFT JOIN checkout_actions ca ON cs.session_id = ca.session_id;

turns.text: The **social** channel's cost per booking rose the most from the week of 14 September 2026 to the week of 21 September 2026, increasing by **27 EUR** (from 98 EUR to 125 EUR).

args.sql:
WITH spend_by_week AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          DATE_TRUNC(s.spend_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(s.spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS s
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE s.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY c.channel,
            week_start),
     bookings_by_week AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          DATE_TRUNC(b.booked_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          COUNT(b.booking_id) AS total_bookings
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings` AS b
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON b.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE b.booked_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY c.channel,
            week_start),
     channels AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT channel
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns`),
     weeks AS
  (SELECT DATE '2026-09-14' AS week_start
   UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2026-09-21' AS week_start),
     grid AS
  (SELECT channels.channel,
          weeks.week_start
   FROM channels
   CROSS JOIN weeks),
     metrics AS
  (SELECT g.channel,
          g.week_start,
          COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) AS total_spend,
          COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0) AS total_bookings,
          SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0), COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0)) AS cost_per_booking
   FROM grid g
   LEFT JOIN spend_by_week s ON g.channel = s.channel
   AND g.week_start = s.week_start
   LEFT JOIN bookings_by_week b ON g.channel = b.channel
   AND g.week_start = b.week_start),
     pivoted AS
  (SELECT channel,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = DATE '2026-09-14' THEN cost_per_booking
              END) AS cpb_w14,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = DATE '2026-09-21' THEN cost_per_booking
              END) AS cpb_w21
   FROM metrics
   GROUP BY channel)
SELECT channel,
       cpb_w14,
       cpb_w21,
       cpb_w21 - cpb_w14 AS increase_eur
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY increase_eur DESC NULLS LAST

WITH customer_order_history AS

  (SELECT l.lead_id,
          l.created_date,
          b.booked_date,
          CASE
              WHEN b.booking_id IS NOT NULL
                   AND DATE_DIFF(b.booked_date, l.created_date, DAY) >= 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_search_leads,
       SUM(is_converted_30d) AS converted_leads_30d,

WITH fiscal_bounds AS
  (SELECT fiscal_year AS fy_start_date,
          DATE '2026-10-06' AS as_of_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine`
   WHERE date_day = DATE '2026-10-06' ),
     revenue_calc AS

   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o
   CROSS JOIN fiscal_bounds AS fb
   WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'
     AND o.order_date >= fb.fy_start_date
     AND o.order_date <= fb.as_of_date ),

WITH weeks AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start_date,
          DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(MONDAY)), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS week_end_date
   FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY('2026-08-17', '2026-09-27', INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS d),
     weekly_orders AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(order_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start_date,
          SUM(CASE
                  WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN amount
                  ELSE 0
              END) AS gross_revenue_eur,
          COUNT(CASE
                    WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN order_id
                END) AS non_cancelled_orders,
          COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY week_start_date),
     weekly_returns AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(return_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start_date,
          SUM(amount) AS returns_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns`
   WHERE return_date BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY week_start_date),
     weekly_bookings AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(booked_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start_date,
          SUM(amount) AS booking_value_eur,
          COUNT(booking_id) AS total_bookings
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings`
   WHERE booked_date BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY week_start_date)
SELECT w.week_start_date,
       w.week_end_date,
       COALESCE(o.gross_revenue_eur, 0) AS gross_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(r.returns_eur, 0) AS returns_eur,
       COALESCE(o.gross_revenue_eur, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_eur, 0) AS net_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(o.non_cancelled_orders, 0) AS non_cancelled_orders,
       COALESCE(b.booking_value_eur, 0) AS booking_value_eur,
       COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0) AS total_bookings
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN weekly_orders o ON w.week_start_date = o.week_start_date
LEFT JOIN weekly_returns r ON w.week_start_date = r.week_start_date

WITH weekly_spend AS

          SUM(ad_spend.spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS ad_spend
   INNER JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS campaigns ON ad_spend.campaign_id = campaigns.campaign_id
   WHERE ad_spend.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY campaigns.channel,
            week_start),
     weekly_bookings AS
  (SELECT campaigns.channel,
          DATE_TRUNC(bookings.booked_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          COUNT(bookings.booking_id) AS total_bookings
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings` AS bookings
   INNER JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS campaigns ON bookings.campaign_id = campaigns.campaign_id
   WHERE bookings.booked_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY campaigns.channel,
            week_start),
     channel_weeks AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT channel,
                   DATE '2026-09-14' AS week_start
   FROM weekly_spend
   UNION DISTINCT SELECT DISTINCT channel,
                                  DATE '2026-09-21' AS week_start
   FROM weekly_spend),
     weekly_metrics AS
  (SELECT cw.channel,
          cw.week_start,
          COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) AS spend,
          COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0) AS bookings,
          SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0), COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0)) AS cost_per_booking
   FROM channel_weeks cw
   LEFT JOIN weekly_spend s ON cw.channel = s.channel
   AND cw.week_start = s.week_start
   LEFT JOIN weekly_bookings b ON cw.channel = b.channel
   AND cw.week_start = b.week_start)
SELECT w1.channel,
       w1.spend AS spend_w1,
       w1.bookings AS bookings_w1,
       w1.cost_per_booking AS cost_per_booking_w1,
       w2.spend AS spend_w2,
       w2.bookings AS bookings_w2,
       w2.cost_per_booking AS cost_per_booking_w2,
       (w2.cost_per_booking - w1.cost_per_booking) AS cost_per_booking_diff
FROM weekly_metrics w1
INNER JOIN weekly_metrics w2 ON w1.channel = w2.channel

WITH spend_by_channel AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          SUM(s.spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS s
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE s.spend_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
     AND LOWER(c.channel) IN ('social',
                              'search')
   GROUP BY c.channel),
     leads_by_channel AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          COUNT(l.lead_id) AS total_leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads` AS l
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE l.created_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
     AND LOWER(c.channel) IN ('social',
                              'search')
   GROUP BY c.channel),
     metrics AS
  (SELECT COALESCE(s.channel, l.channel) AS channel,
          COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) AS total_spend,
          COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0) AS total_leads,
          SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0), COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0)) AS cost_per_lead_eur
   FROM spend_by_channel AS s
   FULL OUTER JOIN leads_by_channel AS l ON s.channel = l.channel)
SELECT channel,
       total_spend,
       total_leads,
       cost_per_lead_eur,
       (MAX(CASE
                WHEN channel = 'social' THEN cost_per_lead_eur
            END) OVER () - MAX(CASE
                                   WHEN channel = 'search' THEN cost_per_lead_eur
                               END) OVER ()) AS social_minus_search_diff_eur
FROM metrics
ORDER BY channel;

turns.text: Yes, average daily revenue was slightly higher on weekends than on weekdays between 17 August and 27 September 2026: * **Weekends (Saturdays & Sundays):** **€389.71** per day across 12 days (Total: €4,676.50) * **Other Days (Monday – Friday):** **€385.88** per day across 30 days (Total: €11,576.25) ### Revenue Comparison Insight Average daily revenue on weekends (€389.71) is approximately 1.0% higher than on weekdays (€385.88), showing consistent daily performance throughout the entire 6-week period.

WITH calendar AS
  (SELECT date_day,
          EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK
                  FROM date_day) AS day_of_week,
          CASE
              WHEN EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK
                           FROM date_day) IN (1,
                                              7) THEN 'Weekend (Saturday & Sunday)'
              ELSE 'Weekday (Monday - Friday)'
          END AS day_type
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine`
   WHERE date_day BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-17' AND DATE '2026-09-27' ),
     daily_rev AS
  (SELECT c.date_day,
          c.day_type,
          COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS revenue
   FROM calendar c
   LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` o ON c.date_day = o.order_date
   AND LOWER(o.status) != 'cancelled'
   GROUP BY c.date_day,
            c.day_type)
SELECT dr.day_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT dr.date_day) AS total_days,
       ROUND(SUM(dr.revenue), 2) AS total_revenue_eur,
       ROUND(AVG(dr.revenue), 2) AS avg_daily_revenue_eur
FROM daily_rev dr
GROUP BY dr.day_type
ORDER BY dr.day_type DESC;

For search leads created in September 2026, the lead-to-booking rate (win rate / conversion rate) was **33.70%**, with **31** out of **92** leads converted into bookings within 30 days.

WITH search_campaigns AS
  (SELECT campaign_id
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns`
   WHERE LOWER(channel) = 'search' ),
     sep_search_leads AS
  (SELECT l.lead_id,
          l.created_date,
          b.booking_id,
          b.booked_date,
          CASE
              WHEN b.booking_id IS NOT NULL
                   AND DATE_DIFF(b.booked_date, l.created_date, DAY) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN 1
              ELSE 0
          END AS is_converted_30d,
          CASE
              WHEN b.booking_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1
              ELSE 0
          END AS is_booked_total
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads` AS l
   INNER JOIN search_campaigns AS c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings` AS b ON l.lead_id = b.lead_id
   WHERE l.created_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' )
SELECT COUNT(lead_id) AS total_search_leads,
       SUM(is_converted_30d) AS converted_leads_30d,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(is_converted_30d), COUNT(lead_id)) * 100, 2) AS lead_to_booking_rate_pct,
       SUM(is_booked_total) AS total_booked_leads,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(is_booked_total), COUNT(lead_id)) * 100, 2) AS total_booking_rate_pct
FROM sep_search_leads;

WITH current_date_ref AS
  (SELECT DATE '2026-10-01' AS today),
     weeks AS
  (-- Today is Thursday 2026-10-01.
 -- In BigQuery / standard calendar, ISO weeks or standard Monday-Sunday full weeks:
 -- 2026-10-01 is Thursday.
 -- Current week starts on Monday 2026-09-28.
 -- Last full week (Week 1 prior): Monday 2026-09-21 to Sunday 2026-09-27.
 -- Two weeks prior (Week 2 prior): Monday 2026-09-14 to Sunday 2026-09-20.
 -- Combined last two full weeks: 2026-09-14 to 2026-09-27.
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(today, INTERVAL 2 WEEK), WEEK(MONDAY)) AS start_date,
        DATE_SUB(DATE_TRUNC(today, WEEK(MONDAY)), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS end_date
   FROM current_date_ref)

WITH fy_start AS
  (SELECT fiscal_year
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine`
   WHERE date_day = DATE '2026-10-06' ),
     rev AS
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS revenue_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` o
   CROSS JOIN fy_start
   WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'
     AND o.order_date >= fy_start.fiscal_year
     AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-10-06' ),
     ret AS
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) AS returns_eur

   WHERE r.return_date >= fy_start.fiscal_year
     AND r.return_date <= DATE '2026-10-06' )
SELECT rev.revenue_eur,
       ret.returns_eur,
       (rev.revenue_eur - ret.returns_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM rev
CROSS JOIN ret

turns.text: I assumed 'week' refers to standard Monday-to-Sunday calendar weeks and evaluated performance primarily based on order Revenue (EUR), as well as Booking Value (EUR). Our best week between Monday 17 August and Sunday 27 September 2026 was the week of **Monday 21 September to Sunday 27 September 2026**, bringing in **€3,387.25** in revenue across 26 non-cancelled orders (and **€33,300.00** in booking value across 13 bookings). ### Peak Performance The final week (21–27 September 2026) generated the highest revenue (€3,387.25) and highest booking value (€33,300.00) in the 6-week window, representing a **58.2% increase** in weekly order revenue compared to the starting week of 17–23 August (€2,141.25).

args.sql:
WITH date_weeks AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start_date,
          DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(MONDAY)), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS week_end_date
   FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY('2026-08-17', '2026-09-27', INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS d),
     weekly_orders AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(o.order_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start_date,
          SUM(CASE
                  WHEN LOWER(o.status) != 'cancelled' THEN o.amount
                  ELSE 0
              END) AS revenue_eur,
          COUNT(CASE
                    WHEN LOWER(o.status) != 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id
                END) AS non_cancelled_orders,
          COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o
   WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY 1),
     weekly_returns AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(r.return_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start_date,
          SUM(r.amount) AS returns_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns` AS r
   WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY 1),
     weekly_bookings AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(b.booked_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start_date,
          COUNT(b.booking_id) AS bookings_count,
          SUM(b.amount) AS booking_value_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings` AS b
   WHERE b.booked_date BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY 1)
SELECT w.week_start_date,
       w.week_end_date,
       COALESCE(wo.revenue_eur, 0) AS revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(wr.returns_eur, 0) AS returns_eur,
       COALESCE(wo.revenue_eur, 0) - COALESCE(wr.returns_eur, 0) AS net_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(wo.non_cancelled_orders, 0) AS non_cancelled_orders,
       COALESCE(wb.bookings_count, 0) AS bookings_count,
       COALESCE(wb.booking_value_eur, 0) AS booking_value_eur
FROM date_weeks AS w
LEFT JOIN weekly_orders AS wo ON w.week_start_date = wo.week_start_date
LEFT JOIN weekly_returns AS wr ON w.week_start_date = wr.week_start_date
LEFT JOIN weekly_bookings AS wb ON w.week_start_date = wb.week_start_date
ORDER BY w.week_start_date;

   GROUP BY week_start,
            c.channel),
     weekly_metrics AS
  (SELECT COALESCE(s.week_start, b.week_start) AS week_start,
          COALESCE(s.channel, b.channel) AS channel,
          COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) AS total_spend,
          COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0) AS total_bookings,
          SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0), b.total_bookings) AS cost_per_booking
   FROM weekly_spend AS s

   AND s.channel = b.channel),

              END) AS bookings_w2,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = '2026-09-21' THEN cost_per_booking
              END) AS cpb_w2
   FROM weekly_metrics
   GROUP BY channel)
SELECT channel,
       cpb_w1 AS cost_per_booking_sep14,
       cpb_w2 AS cost_per_booking_sep21,
       (cpb_w2 - cpb_w1) AS cpb_increase_eur

args.sql:
WITH order_history AS
  (SELECT order_id,
          customer_id,
          order_date,
          amount,
          status,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id
                             ORDER BY order_ts,
                                      order_id) AS order_seq
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`),
     period_orders AS
  (SELECT order_id,
          customer_id,
          order_date,
          amount,
          status,
          order_seq,
          CASE
              WHEN order_seq = 1 THEN 'first_time'
              ELSE 'repeat'
          END AS buyer_type
   FROM order_history
   WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
     AND status != 'cancelled' ),
     overall_repeat_definition AS
  (-- Also checking the glossary definition:
 -- "Repeat customers: Distinct customers with a non-cancelled order in the period who have placed two or more orders in all."
 -- Let's calculate both order sequence (1st order vs >1st order) and customer-level order counts
 SELECT customer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_orders_all_time
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT -- Metric calculation based on order number:
 AVG(CASE
         WHEN p.order_seq = 1 THEN p.amount
     END) AS avg_first_time_order_eur,
 AVG(CASE
         WHEN p.order_seq > 1 THEN p.amount
     END) AS avg_repeat_order_eur,
 AVG(CASE
         WHEN p.order_seq > 1 THEN p.amount
     END) - AVG(CASE
                    WHEN p.order_seq = 1 THEN p.amount
                END) AS diff_by_order_seq, -- Metric calculation based on customer lifetime order count (1 order vs 2+ orders):
 AVG(CASE
         WHEN ord.total_orders_all_time = 1 THEN p.amount
     END) AS avg_single_order_cust_eur,
 AVG(CASE
         WHEN ord.total_orders_all_time >= 2 THEN p.amount
     END) AS avg_repeat_cust_eur,
 AVG(CASE
         WHEN ord.total_orders_all_time >= 2 THEN p.amount
     END) - AVG(CASE
                    WHEN ord.total_orders_all_time = 1 THEN p.amount
                END) AS diff_by_cust_repeat_status,

WITH daily_metrics AS
  (SELECT o.order_date,
          SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount,
          SUM(CASE
                  WHEN o.status != 'cancelled' THEN o.amount
                  ELSE 0
              END) AS revenue,
          COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) AS returns_amount
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o
   LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns` AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
   WHERE o.order_date IN ('2026-10-01',
                          '2026-10-02')
   GROUP BY o.order_date),
     totals AS
  (SELECT 'Total (Oct 1 - Oct 2, 2026)' AS period,
          SUM(total_order_amount) AS total_order_amount,
          SUM(revenue) AS revenue,
          SUM(returns_amount) AS returns_amount,
          ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(returns_amount), SUM(revenue)) * 100, 2) AS refund_rate_pct_of_revenue,
          ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(returns_amount), SUM(total_order_amount)) * 100, 2) AS refund_rate_pct_of_total_orders
   FROM daily_metrics),
     breakdown AS
  (SELECT CAST(order_date AS STRING) AS period,
          total_order_amount,
          revenue,
          returns_amount,
          ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(returns_amount, revenue) * 100, 2) AS refund_rate_pct_of_revenue,
          ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(returns_amount, total_order_amount) * 100, 2) AS refund_rate_pct_of_total_orders
   FROM daily_metrics)
SELECT *
FROM totals
UNION ALL
SELECT *

WITH date_ranges AS
  (SELECT DATE '2026-09-14' AS week_start,
          DATE '2026-09-20' AS week_end,
          '2026-09-14' AS week_label
   UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2026-09-21' AS week_start,
                    DATE '2026-09-27' AS week_end,
                    '2026-09-21' AS week_label),
     spend_by_week_channel AS
  (SELECT d.week_label,
          c.channel,
          SUM(s.spend) AS total_spend
   FROM date_ranges d
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` s ON s.spend_date BETWEEN d.week_start AND d.week_end
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   GROUP BY d.week_label,
            c.channel),
     bookings_by_week_channel AS
  (SELECT d.week_label,
          c.channel,
          COUNT(b.booking_id) AS total_bookings
   FROM date_ranges d
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings` b ON b.booked_date BETWEEN d.week_start AND d.week_end
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` c ON b.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   GROUP BY d.week_label,
            c.channel),
     channel_metrics AS
  (SELECT COALESCE(s.week_label, b.week_label) AS week_label,
          COALESCE(s.channel, b.channel) AS channel,
          COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) AS total_spend,
          COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0) AS total_bookings,
          SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0), COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0)) AS cost_per_booking
   FROM spend_by_week_channel s
   FULL OUTER JOIN bookings_by_week_channel b ON s.week_label = b.week_label
   AND s.channel = b.channel)
SELECT w1.channel,
       w1.total_spend AS spend_w1,
       w1.total_bookings AS bookings_w1,
       w1.cost_per_booking AS cpb_w1,
       w2.total_spend AS spend_w2,
       w2.total_bookings AS bookings_w2,
       w2.cost_per_booking AS cpb_w2,
       w2.cost_per_booking - w1.cost_per_booking AS cpb_diff
FROM
  (SELECT *
   FROM channel_metrics
   WHERE week_label = '2026-09-14') w1
FULL OUTER JOIN
  (SELECT *
   FROM channel_metrics
   WHERE week_label = '2026-09-21') w2 ON w1.channel = w2.channel
ORDER BY cpb_diff DESC;

WITH spend_data AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          SUM(s.spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS s
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE s.spend_date >= '2026-09-01'
     AND s.spend_date <= '2026-09-30'
     AND LOWER(c.channel) IN ('social',
                              'search')
   GROUP BY c.channel),
     leads_data AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          COUNT(l.lead_id) AS total_leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads` AS l
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE l.created_date >= '2026-09-01'
     AND l.created_date <= '2026-09-30'
     AND LOWER(c.channel) IN ('social',
                              'search')
   GROUP BY c.channel),
     channel_cpl AS
  (SELECT COALESCE(s.channel, l.channel) AS channel,
          COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) AS total_spend,
          COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0) AS total_leads,
          SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0), COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0)) AS cost_per_lead_eur
   FROM spend_data s
   FULL OUTER JOIN leads_data l ON s.channel = l.channel)
SELECT channel,
       total_spend,
       total_leads,
       cost_per_lead_eur,
       (MAX(CASE
                WHEN LOWER(channel) = 'social' THEN cost_per_lead_eur
            END) OVER () - MAX(CASE
                                   WHEN LOWER(channel) = 'search' THEN cost_per_lead_eur
                               END) OVER ()) AS diff_social_minus_search_eur
FROM channel_cpl
ORDER BY channel;

 COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS daily_revenue
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine` AS ts
   LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o ON ts.date_day = o.order_date
   AND LOWER(o.status) != 'cancelled'
   WHERE ts.date_day BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-17' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY ts.date_day,
            dow,
            day_type)
SELECT day_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT date_day) AS total_days,
       ROUND(SUM(daily_revenue), 2) AS total_revenue_eur,
       ROUND(AVG(daily_revenue), 2) AS avg_daily_revenue_eur
FROM daily_orders
GROUP BY day_type
ORDER BY day_type DESC;

The corresponding cost per lead was **€42.07** across 92 leads. I assumed CPA refers to Cost per Booking (cost per conversion) as defined in the business glossary. Cost per lead is also provided for reference. ### Acquisition Efficiency The search channel generated 31 bookings from 92 leads with a total ad spend of €3,870, yielding an average cost per conversion of €124.84 and a lead conversion rate of approximately 33.7%.

WITH search_campaigns AS
  (SELECT campaign_id,
          channel,
          name
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns`
   WHERE LOWER(channel) = 'search' ),
     spend_data AS
  (SELECT SUM(s.spend) AS total_spend_eur,
          SUM(s.clicks) AS total_clicks,
          SUM(s.impressions) AS total_impressions
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS s
   INNER JOIN search_campaigns AS c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE s.spend_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' ),
     booking_data AS
  (SELECT COUNT(b.booking_id) AS total_bookings,
          SUM(b.amount) AS total_booking_value_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings` AS b
   INNER JOIN search_campaigns AS c ON b.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE b.booked_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' ),
     lead_data AS
  (SELECT COUNT(l.lead_id) AS total_leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads` AS l
   INNER JOIN search_campaigns AS c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE l.created_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' )
SELECT spend_data.total_spend_eur,
       booking_data.total_bookings,
       lead_data.total_leads,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(spend_data.total_spend_eur, booking_data.total_bookings), 2) AS cost_per_booking_eur,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(spend_data.total_spend_eur, lead_data.total_leads), 2) AS cost_per_lead_eur
FROM spend_data
CROSS JOIN booking_data
CROSS JOIN lead_data;

WITH orders_agg AS

   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`

WITH daily_rev AS
  (SELECT order_date,
          SUM(amount) AS revenue_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE LOWER(status) != 'cancelled'
     AND order_date IN ('2026-09-17',
                        '2026-09-24')
   GROUP BY order_date)
SELECT r_curr.order_date AS CURRENT_DATE,
       r_curr.revenue_eur AS current_revenue_eur,
       r_prev.order_date AS previous_date,
       r_prev.revenue_eur AS previous_revenue_eur,
       r_curr.revenue_eur - r_prev.revenue_eur AS revenue_change_eur,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(r_curr.revenue_eur - r_prev.revenue_eur, r_prev.revenue_eur) * 100, 2) AS wow_growth_pct
FROM daily_rev r_curr
LEFT JOIN daily_rev r_prev ON r_prev.order_date = DATE_SUB(r_curr.order_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
WHERE r_curr.order_date = '2026-09-24'
